nodes.description: Mapping tokenId => Auction struct storing reservePrice, startTime, endTime and resulted flag for every auction.
Mapping tokenId => HighestBid struct escrowing the current top bidder, bid amount and last bid time.
ISateNFT interface reference to the only NFT collection that can be auctioned.
IERC20 STARL token used as the bidding currency and for fee payouts.
Global minimum amount by which a new bid must outbid the previous highest bid.
Global lock time a highest bidder must wait before withdrawing their bid.
Designer fee in tenths of a percent, used to compute the creator payout.
Vault fee in tenths of a percent, used to compute the vault payout.
Payable address receiving the residual dev portion of the winning bid.
Payable address of the Starlink rewards vault receiving the vault fee.
Owner address inherited from Ownable that gates all onlyOwner administrative functions.
onlyOwner entry point that validates NFT approval and delegates to _createAuction.
Payable bidding entry point: blocks contracts, validates the auction window and outbid thresholds, pulls STARL, refunds the previous top bidder and then stores the new highest bid.
Allows the current highest bidder to withdraw after the lock time and before auction end; deletes the bid before refunding.
onlyOwner settlement that marks the auction resulted, splits the winning bid into designer/vault/dev fees and transfers the NFT to the winner.
onlyOwner cancellation that refunds the top bidder and deletes the auction.
onlyOwner setter for the global minimum bid increment.
onlyOwner setter for the global bid withdrawal lock time.
onlyOwner setter that updates an existing auction's reserve price.
onlyOwner setter that updates an existing auction's start time without validation.
onlyOwner setter that updates an auction end time after validating it is after start and before now.
onlyOwner setter for the designer fee, unvalidated against an upper bound.
onlyOwner setter for the vault fee, unvalidated against an upper bound.
View accessor returning all auction parameters for a token id.
View accessor returning the current highest bidder, bid amount and last bid time.
Internal virtual time source returning block.timestamp; used for every auction window check.
Private helper that validates times and writes the new Auction struct into storage.
Private helper that performs an external ERC20 transfer back to a previous highest bidder.
Ownable onlyOwner function transferring the _owner state variable.
Ownable onlyOwner function renouncing ownership by zeroing _owner.
Caller controlled address used for bidder identity, ownership checks and contract-caller griefing check.
Miner influenced timestamp consumed through _getNow for all auction window and lock time logic.
External ERC20 pull of the bid amount from the bidder into the auction contract; invokes untrusted token code.
External ERC20 transfer sending escrowed funds or fees to a bidder, creator, vault or dev recipient.
External NFT transfer delivering the auctioned token to the winner; invokes untrusted NFT code with onERC721Received callback.
Low-level value call in Address.sendValue forwarding all gas to an arbitrary recipient.
Token id of the NFT being listed for auction.
Minimum acceptable bid for the auction.
Unix timestamp when bidding opens.
Unix timestamp when bidding closes.
Token id of the auction being bid on.
Caller supplied bid amount of STARL tokens.
Token id whose highest bid the caller wants to withdraw.
Token id of the auction being finalized.
Token id of the auction being cancelled.
Payable address of the bidder being refunded.
Escrowed STARL amount being returned.
New owner address proposed by the current owner.
Storage pointer to auctions[_tokenId] used to read the bidding window and reserve price.
Storage pointer to highestBids[_tokenId] holding the incumbent bidder and bid.
highestBid.bid + minBidIncrement; the floor for the new bid.
Copy of the winning bid amount used for price recording and fee math.
winningBid * designerFee / 1000 payout to the NFT creator.
winningBid * vaultFee / 1000 payout to the vault.
Snapshot of the bid amount taken before deleting the highest bid record.
Address of the highest bidder being settled.
New global minimum bid increment value.
New global withdrawal lock duration.
Token id of the auction whose reserve price is updated.
New reserve price value.
Token id of the auction whose start time is updated.
New auction start time.
Token id of the auction whose end time is updated.
New auction end time.
New designer fee value.
New vault fee value.
Token id queried for auction parameters.
Token id queried for highest bidder info.

edges.reason: createAuction consumes the _tokenId parameter for the approval check and listing.
createAuction consumes _reservePrice when building the auction.
createAuction consumes _startTimestamp for the auction window.
createAuction consumes _endTimestamp for the auction window.
_tokenId is forwarded into _createAuction.
_reservePrice is forwarded into _createAuction.
_startTimestamp is forwarded into _createAuction.
_endTimestamp is forwarded into _createAuction.
placeBid indexes auctions and highestBids with the caller supplied _tokenId.
placeBid uses the caller supplied _amount as the proposed bid.
withdrawBid loads the highest bid record for _tokenId.
resultAuction loads and settles the auction for _tokenId.
cancelAuction loads and deletes the auction for _tokenId.
_currentHighestBidder is the destination of the refund transfer.
_currentHighestBid is the amount returned by the refund transfer.
newOwner becomes the new _owner, gated by onlyOwner.
_minBidIncrement is written into the minBidIncrement state variable.
_bidWithdrawalLockTime is written into the bidWithdrawalLockTime state variable.
_tokenId selects the auction storage slot to update.
_reservePrice is written into the auction reserve price.
_tokenId selects the auction storage slot to update.
_startTime is written into the auction start time without ordering checks.
_tokenId selects the auction storage slot to update.
_endTimestamp is written into the auction end time.
_designerFee is written into the designerFee state variable.
_vaultFee is written into the vaultFee state variable.
_tokenId is the lookup key for the getAuction view.
_tokenId is the lookup key for the getHighestBidder view.
msg.sender is checked with isContract, funds the safeTransferFrom and becomes highestBid.bidder.
msg.sender must equal highestBid.bidder to be allowed to withdraw.
msg.sender is compared against owner() by the onlyOwner modifier on createAuction.
msg.sender is compared against owner() by the onlyOwner modifier on resultAuction.
msg.sender is compared against owner() by the onlyOwner modifier on cancelAuction.
msg.sender must be the current owner to transfer ownership.
_getNow returns block.timestamp, making all auction timing miner-influenceable.
placeBid compares block.timestamp against auction.startTime and auction.endTime.
withdrawBid compares block.timestamp against lastBidTime + lock time and the auction end.
resultAuction requires block.timestamp to be past the auction end time.
_createAuction requires the end timestamp to be after block.timestamp.
updateAuctionEndTime requires the new end timestamp to be in the future per block.timestamp.
placeBid reads the Auction struct from the auctions mapping.
placeBid reads and rewrites the HighestBid struct in the highestBids mapping.
withdrawBid reads auctions[_tokenId].endTime.
withdrawBid deletes the highestBids entry after refunding.
resultAuction reads and sets the auction resulted flag and end time.
resultAuction reads and deletes the highest bid record.
cancelAuction reads and deletes the auction entry.
cancelAuction reads and deletes the highest bid entry.
_createAuction checks auctions[_tokenId].endTime and writes a new Auction struct.
updateAuctionReservePrice checks endTime and writes reservePrice.
updateAuctionStartTime checks endTime and writes startTime.
updateAuctionEndTime checks startTime/endTime and writes endTime.
getAuction returns fields from the auctions mapping.
getHighestBidder returns fields from the highestBids mapping.
placeBid invokes the STARL token for the bid pull.
resultAuction uses the STARL token for all fee payouts.
_refundHighestBidder uses the STARL token to refund.
resultAuction calls sateNft.creators, ownerOf and safeTransferFrom.
createAuction calls sateNft.isApproved before listing.
_createAuction is only reachable after the NFT approval check that guards the auctioned asset.
minBidIncrement is added to the incumbent bid to derive the new minimum.
updateMinBidIncrement writes the global increment.
bidWithdrawalLockTime gates when the top bidder may withdraw.
updateBidWithdrawalLockTime writes the global lock time.
designerFee scales the creator payout during settlement.
updateDesignerFee writes the designer fee.
vaultFee scales the vault payout during settlement.
updateVaultFee writes the vault fee.
devFeeRecipient receives the residual winning bid.
vault receives the vault fee share of the winning bid.
transferOwnership overwrites the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership zeroes the _owner state variable.
minBidRequired is computed as highestBid.bid.add(minBidIncrement).
highestBid is a storage pointer into highestBids[_tokenId].
auction is a storage pointer into auctions[_tokenId].
The caller supplied _amount is compared against the stored reserve price.
winningBid is copied from the highest bidder record.
designerFeeAmount = winningBid.mul(designerFee).div(1000), fee math depends on unvalidated fee state.
vaultFeeAmount = winningBid.mul(vaultFee).div(1000), fee math depends on unvalidated fee state.
winner is copied from the highest bidder record before deletion.
previousBid snapshots highestBid.bid before the record is deleted.
createAuction transfers control to _createAuction after the approval check.
placeBid performs the external refund to the previous top bidder BEFORE writing the new highestBid state and lastBidTime.
withdrawBid triggers an external refund; the highestBids entry is deleted first, which is the safe ordering.
cancelAuction calls the external refund helper while the auction record is still live.
placeBid pulls funds through an external ERC20 call which may execute untrusted token code before state is reconciled.
The refund helper performs an external ERC20 transfer to an arbitrary bidder address.
resultAuction makes several external ERC20 transfers to creator, vault and dev recipient.
resultAuction calls safeTransferFrom on the NFT, invoking onERC721Received on the winner if it is a contract.
SafeERC20 wraps the transfer in a low-level call (Address.functionCall) to an externally controlled token address.
SafeERC20 _callOptionalReturn uses Address.functionCall, a low-level call with return-data decoding.
Address.sendValue's value call is the canonical all-gas external send path used by payable recipients.
updateMinBidIncrement overwrites the global minimum increment; only the owner may call it.
updateBidWithdrawalLockTime overwrites the global lock time; only the owner may call it.
updateDesignerFee overwrites the designer fee with no upper bound check.
updateVaultFee overwrites the vault fee with no upper bound check.
renounceOwnership permanently zeroes the owner, disabling all administrative functions.
